name: field-types
body: Field types: `text` (inline Markdown; `plain` flag strips styles silently), `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `enum`, `image` (path under assets/, existence checked), `link` (#label checked or http(s) URL), `list` (exactly one item type), and a section template used as a field type for structured YAML data (e.g. `people: {type: list, of: person}`). No separate record types.
